definitions.explanation: Money or assets used for investment or starting a business.
Accumulated wealth used for producing more wealth.

examples.english: In capitalist countries, individuals are free to use capital to start businesses.

notes:
{資本|しほん} refers to capital - money or assets used for business or investment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資本金|しほんきん}→資本金：noentry⟧ (capital, paid-in capital)
- {資本|しほん}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (capitalism)
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧{資本|しほん} (foreign capital)
- {資本|しほん}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (capital investment)
- {資本|しほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投入|とうにゅう}→投入：12895_tounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to invest capital)

USAGE:
{資本|しほん} can be used figuratively to mean one's assets or advantages:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{資本|しほん} (your body is your capital)
- ⟦{若|わか}さ→若さ：20335_wakasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{資本|しほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (using youth as one's capital)
